propositions: The rebar metrics subcommand must parse --since/--until date range arguments and --output format (json|text) and render the full metric registry over that range.

The metrics command is wired as an explicit if sub == 'metrics' dispatch arm in _cli/__init__.py on the reads path, and metrics is added to the individual frozenset in test_help_overview_coverage.py to satisfy routable subcommand coverage.

The metrics.py command must import rebar.metrics (the package) to trigger reader module registration and hydrate REGISTRY before evaluating each MetricSpec; it must NOT directly import any rebar.metrics.adapters module.

Each metric is evaluated within a context object carrying repo_root, since, and until; the render loop catches exceptions per metric and renders failures as unavailable rather than crashing the whole command.

JSON output (default) emits {since, until, metrics: {id: {lens, source, confidence, value} | {unavailable: {reason, accruing_since}}}}, and --output text prints one deterministic human line per metric with id, lens/source, and value-or-unavailable.
All CLI help text files and golden snapshots are regenerated, and the portability guard asserts no rebar.metrics.adapters imports in metrics.py source.
